tasks.subject: B1: Agent + AgentRun Prisma models
tasks.description: See native task #7 (TaskGet) for full Goal/Files/Acceptance Criteria/Verify. Plan doc: Task 1. No dependency on the model-catalog plan — can start immediately. Schema edits committed at 9b6c701 (spec + quality review both approved). `npx prisma migrate dev --name add_agents` could NOT be run to completion: no DATABASE_URL is configured anywhere in this worktree (no .env file; .env.sample has DATABASE_URL=""), so the command fails at config-load time with PrismaConfigEnvError. `npx prisma generate`/`validate` were confirmed to work against a scoped, non-persisted dummy DATABASE_URL, proving the schema itself is valid; no migration folder exists under prisma/migrations/. A real DATABASE_URL must be provisioned before `prisma migrate dev --name add_agents` can actually run and be committed (git add prisma/migrations).
